svg.title: Security and trust boundaries
svg.desc: Which component holds which credential, what crosses each boundary, and the checks applied on the way.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: App: holds only a Firebase session and short-lived capabilities; verifies every response and download

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: API: Firestore service account, Supabase secret; never trusts client IDs

div.style: color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: CPU worker and GPU runner: same scoped cloud credentials; GPU runner also holds the Gemini key

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: FFmpeg and model adapters: empty environment, no credentials, own process group, time limits

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Model runtime: no cloud keys; owner-only Unix socket; accepts only its staging file names

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Firestore: deny-all client rules; server access only

div.style: color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Supabase: private buckets, signed upload and read capabilities

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Gemini: receives lesson video only after the user consents
